description: A partial binds a map-typed value to an attribute (:data-config="state.Config"), forcing the emitter to serialise it with json.Marshal. Regression test: the go-literal emitter must register the encoding/json import on demand wherever it emits a json.Marshal call. Partials do not receive the page-level encoding/json keep-alive boilerplate, so without on-demand registration the partial's generated code fails to compile with 'undefined: json'.
